Title: Python Midterm

Last Question.Name: Last King's Downfall
Last Question.Title: Last King's Downfall
Last Question.Text: What was the cause of the Last King's downfall?

CCU Quest: Find the Tomb of the Last King in the South West and watch out for trolls!
Entry: You enter through the ancient doors of the last king of the Lost Kingdom. The pillared room ends at a rickety oak bridge over a deep chasm.
Quest: You are the green dot in your cabin at the edge of the "Half-way There Woodland Grove". Move about the map and find treasure to claim your coins. But beware, you will have to answer questions to earn your discovery (you can also lose coins). The better the coin - the harder the question. Use the arrow keys, WASD, or the mouse to move. Press the escape key if you get stuck and can't move - but beware, that can distort reality. There is a compass pointing to your destination. You can't move everywhere so avoid unwalkable places such as lava, rivers and hills. You can walk inside or behind some objects. Earn {0} of each coin to complete this quest. There are some weapons and items to find, but they are not needed to complete the quest. You have until your torches run out to complete your quest.
Epilogue:
You have made it back home to your cabin at the edge of the "Half-way There Woodland Grove". It's a beautiful forest and hardly anyone dares enter it. The trees fade in and out of this reality making it easy to get lost and a pain to collect firewood.
You find a note on your door attached with nail polish. In firm but spindly writing it says "Our sisters in Labyrinth of the Amazed have been picking up some bad hobbits lately, and they could use your help."
